title: Fix LiteRouter for Anthropic/OpenRouter native format
description:
LiteRouter hardcodes OpenAI request/response format. Need to:
1. Add streaming support (stop forcing stream=False)
2. Add Anthropic response transformer (like existing gemini.py)
3. Add reasoning_tokens to Usage model
4. Fix model name handling (strip provider prefix upstream)
5. Detect Anthropic vs OpenAI response format per-model
close_reason: Fixed: added streaming support, Anthropic response transformer, reasoning_tokens in Usage model, provider detection helpers, and model name prefix stripping. All changes committed and pushed.
